title: StabilityArc: Decoding Protein Sequence Embeddings into Generalizable Stability Landscapes
abstract: arXiv:2610.00742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Every protein has a unique stability landscape, but the physical consequences of mutation are governed by recurring biochemical constraints. We test whether a shared decoder, trained on measurements from diverse proteins, can interpret these constraints in an unseen target, enabling cross-protein transfer for initial experimental round prescreening. We present StabilityArc , which maps frozen ESMC-600M residue representations through a shared RoPE transformer to an Lx20 matrix of substitution effects; a symmetric, contact-aware residual aids in predicting epistasis in simultaneous substitutions. In 66 strict leave-one-protein-out evaluations covering 134,794 ProteinGym variants, StabilityArc achieves 0.7134 Spearman correlation, exceeding the strongest zero-shot baseline, ProSST-2048 (0.6526), by 0.0608. We further explore the utility of this method by providing the score as a prior for Kermut, achieving Spearman correlation of 0.8280

translated_title: StabilityArc：将蛋白质序列嵌入解码为可泛化的稳定性景观
translated_abstract: 每种蛋白质都有其独特的稳定性景观，但突变的物理后果受制于反复出现的生化约束。我们测试了在多种蛋白质测量数据上训练的共享解码器，能否在未见过的目标蛋白质中解读这些约束，从而实现跨蛋白质迁移，用于初始实验轮次的预筛选。我们提出了 StabilityArc，它将冻结的 ESMC-600M 残基表示通过共享的 RoPE transformer 映射为 Lx20 的替换效应矩阵；一个对称的、接触感知的残差模块有助于预测同时替换中的上位效应。在涵盖 134,794 个 ProteinGym 变异的 66 次严格留一蛋白质评估中，StabilityArc 达到了 0.7134 的 Spearman 相关系数，超过最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048（0.6526）0.0608。我们进一步将该分数作为 Kermut 的先验来探索此方法的实用性，实现了 0.8280 的 Spearman 相关系数。
tldr: StabilityArc 通过在多种蛋白质数据上训练的共享解码器，将冻结的蛋白质序列嵌入解码为可泛化的稳定性景观，实现了跨蛋白质的突变效应零样本迁移预测，其性能超越最强零样本基线，并可作为先验显著提升其他模型的表现。
en_tdlr: StabilityArc uses a shared decoder to decode frozen protein sequence embeddings into generalizable stability landscapes, enabling state-of-the-art zero-shot cross-protein transfer for predicting mutation effects and further boosting models like Kermut when used as a prior.
